resources.string: StudioSnap uses the accessibility service to capture your screen when you press the Screenshot key (it checks key presses only for that shortcut), to read where windows and on-screen elements are for snapping, to read on-screen text when you capture Text, and to scroll a window for Scroll capture. It never sends anything anywhere: StudioSnap has no internet permission, and its code is open source. You can turn this off any time.
